en.html:
Who could doubt the world's extinction?
At this sight—who?

Fuji had lost its beautiful shape. Lava like foul blood poured from it.
A void permitting no life, no continuance, no creation. Nothing but ruin.

Who would live here?
Who would live here?

流している。

破滅以外を許さぬ虚界。

en.html:
Hikaru"With respect for history, Hikaru follows its road. However great my martial power, I will claim no title before showing results!"
Hikaru"And I will not repeat their mistakes!"
Hikaru"Every former conqueror fell into corruption halfway. Satisfied before conquering all humanity, drowned in power, became an incomplete god."
Hikaru"Therefore, overthrown…"
Hikaru"Not me. To the end of the conquering road I go."
Hikaru"Hikaru Minato will challenge all three billion humans, subdue them, and by that fact reach the divine seat!"
Kageaki"Must you cling to that delusion, whatever happens?!"
Hikaru"I must! Delusion, yes! Folly, yes! But this one thought is Hikaru's lifeline!"
Hikaru"First, prepare the stage. This ridiculous power in me… enough to share with everyone under heaven!"
Kageaki"————WHAT?!"
Hikaru"Hikaru wants all humanity defeated and dead for one personal wish. Then all people must have the capacity to resist and reject my will—otherwise, unfair!"
Hikaru"So I bestow it! The law of martial power! Strength and spirit for slaughter and struggle!"
Hikaru"MARTIAL RULE BENEATH HEAVEN! HIKARU MINATO DECREES IT, HERE AND NOW!"

光 「まずは舞台を整えよう。 　今、光に宿るこの戯けた力……天下万民と 分かち合うにも充分だ！」
景明 「――――何を!?」

en.html:
Kageaki"Then… if your father returns and acknowledges you as his daughter, is that enough?"
Kageaki"Will you stop destroying the world?"
Hikaru"…Answered this question before too."
Hikaru"Hikaru wants no sacrificial flesh. A true heart."
Hikaru"Father valued society and order. Therefore refused to call Hikaru his daughter. To protect this present world, perhaps he would hear my wish."
Hikaru"But that will not do! No truth. Only an imitation in the proper shape. I don't want it!"
Hikaru"For truth… destroy everything Father values. Mother Subaru, present human society, all of it. Then ask."
Hikaru"Will you love Hikaru even now? Ninety per cent hatred, fine. Ninety-nine, fine. The one per cent left… just a little, one fragment of a father's love—"
Hikaru"Enough."
Kageaki"…………"
Hikaru"Hikaru will be content."

景明 「なら、お前は…… 　父親が戻り、お前を娘と認めさえすれば、 それで満足するのか？」
景明 「世界の破壊を、思い留まるか？」
光 「……その問いも、以前に答えたな」
光 「光が欲しいのは生贄の肉ではない。 　真実の心」
光 「父は社会と秩序を重んじ、それゆえに光を 娘と認めて下さらなかった。 　だからこそ、現世界を守るためとあらば光 の願いを聞くやもしれぬ」
光 「しかし、それでは駄目なのだ！ 　真実が無い。形ばかりの偽物に過ぎない。 そんなものは欲しくもない！」
光 「真実を得るには…… 　父が尊ぶもの。我が母統を、今の人間社会 を、全て滅ぼし尽くした上で問うのみ」
光 「これでも・・・・光を愛してくれるか、と！ 　九割が憎しみでも構わない。九割九分でも。 残りの一分、ほんの少しだけ……一欠片だけ、 肉親の愛情を示してくれるなら、」
光 「それでいい」
景明 「…………」
光 「それでおれは満ち足りる」

en.html:
I thought of thread.

A tangled bundle.
So complicated I could no longer tell what had made it like this.

The proper method would be to take time and untangle it.

But with no time—

Only one means.
Scissors. Cut.

Sever the knot. Free the threads.

No other way to loosen this tangle.

Only one means.
Scissors. Cut.

Sever the knot. Free the threads.

No other way to loosen this tangle.

ja.html:
糸の存在を想う。

　絡まり合った糸の束。
　複雑過ぎて、何処がどうしてこうなったのか、最早
まるでわからない。

　これを解きほぐすなら、時間を掛けて取り組むのが
正しいやり方だろう。
　
　だが、その時間が無ければ――

　手段は一つだ。
　鋏を使って切るしかない。

　結び目を断ち切って、糸を解放するしかない。
　
　この絡まりを解くには、もうそれしか。

Hikaru"That is your answer, Kageaki?"
Kageaki"…"
Hikaru"I knew. Yes, always Mother's side… never mine."
Hikaru"Mother was my enemy."
Hikaru"Follow Mother's will, and brother Kageaki, you are Hikaru's enemy too!"
Kageaki"…Exactly."
Hikaru"I will defeat you."
Hikaru"Take every bit of the life and soul that serves Mother."
Hikaru"Everything Mother's, this Hikaru takes!"
Kageaki"…………"
Hikaru"Then overthrow the world."
Hikaru"When all is done… with the power in this body, bring back only Father."
Hikaru"Stop me if you CAN!!"
